audit.why: HARD at 37.8% over 82 games is the worst matchup in this slice, and the chart (Heimerdinger 4, Trundle 2, Skill 1) matches: you own level 1 and the level-6 Subjugate window, he owns everything else.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike is described without either of the two cooldowns that decide whether it converts, and the level-3 line claims his stun is 'on a long cooldown'.
audit.why: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a flat 11 seconds at every rank — that is not a long cooldown, and 'bait it then engage properly' is dangerous advice when it returns before your Pillar does (21s at rank 1). UPGRADE!!! is 100/85/70s, which is the actual cooldown worth tracking.
audit.corrected: Stated 11s for the grenade and 100s for UPGRADE!!!, and reframed the bait as buying one engage rather than a lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three issues. (a) Chomp is credited with slowing or suppressing Heimerdinger's attack speed in four separate fields — it does not touch attack speed. (b) The full layer invents an ability called 'CH-3X Lightning Grenade'; no such ability exists in Heimerdinger's kit. (c) The single interaction that explains why chasing him fails is missing entirely: Hextech Affinity gives him move speed while he is near his own turrets, so Frozen Domain's speed bonus does not buy you the chase advantage it normally does.
audit.why: Riot text: Chomp — 'dealing damage, briefly slowing and sapping some of their Attack Damage'. Hextech Affinity — 'Gain Move Speed while near allied towers and turrets deployed by Heimerdinger.' Heimerdinger's E is named CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade and is his only grenade. The page already asserts the right conclusion ('your Frozen Domain's movement speed bonus does not help') for entirely the wrong reason.
audit.corrected: Removed every attack-speed-steal claim, replaced the fabricated grenade name, and named Hextech Affinity as the reason the chase fails.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns lists the grenade twice, once under a fabricated name, and gives no duration for either entry.
audit.why: The whole punish structure of the lane is 11s grenade versus 21s Pillar versus 100s UPGRADE!!!, and none of those numbers appeared.
audit.corrected: Rewrote both cooldown lines with the real name and the real 11s figure, and split the direct-hit stun from the splash slow.

audit.why: The win condition — shove, roam, and save Subjugate for a tanky frontliner in 5v5 rather than duelling Heimerdinger — is the right call at 37.8% and is stated in both late and spikes[3].

edits.before: At level 1 you have a real window — walk up, Q Chomp his first auto-trade before he places a turret, and force him to commit minion aggro. The AS steal from Q hurts him early because he wants to auto-attack between Rocket (W) shots. The problem starts at level 2: the moment he drops an H-28G turret at the wave, he has a stationary DPS platform that punishes every step you take forward. Do not chase him through his own turrets without Frozen Domain (W) already placed to the side; enter from the angle where you can step onto W before the turret cluster reaches you. His CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (E) stun is on a long cooldown at level 3 — bait it by walking up without fully committing, then engage properly once it is burned.
edits.after: At level 1 you have a real window — walk up, Q Chomp his first auto-trade before he places a turret, and force him to commit minion aggro. Chomp saps his AD, which stings early because he still wants to auto between Hextech Micro-Rockets (W). The problem starts at level 2: the moment he drops an H-28G Evolution Turret at the wave, he has a stationary DPS platform punishing every step forward. Do not chase him through his own turrets — Hextech Affinity (P) speeds him up while he stands beside them, so he outruns you inside his zone even with Frozen Domain (W) down. His CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (E) is a flat 11 seconds, so baiting it buys you one engage, not a lane; enter on that window and commit.

edits.after: Once a turret cluster is at his feet, Frozen Domain accomplishes nothing — Hextech Affinity speeds him up beside his own turrets, and their sustained DPS outraces your W healing at these levels.

edits.before: From level 4 onward, Heimerdinger's turrets evolve with his ability rank and the zone they create becomes genuinely lethal to walk through — your Frozen Domain's movement speed bonus does not help when the turrets simply track and shoot you while you cross. Play even on the wave, farm under tower if needed, and do not take extended poke trades; King's Tribute will recover some chip from dying minions but it cannot absorb a sustained Rocket (W) spam plus turret fire. At level 6 you have your best and only real pressure window: Subjugate drains his armor and MR onto you mid-fight, which softens his burst meaningfully for a few seconds. Use Pillar of Ice (E) to block his escape path, drop Frozen Domain (W) so you gain MS to close, and chain Chomp (Q) autos to keep his attack speed suppressed. Even then, if his UPGRADE! turret (R+Q) is down you need jungler follow-up — his enhanced turret hits hard enough to drop you before the second Subjugate cast lands.
edits.after: From level 4 onward, Heimerdinger's turrets scale with his ability rank and the zone becomes genuinely lethal to cross — and Hextech Affinity (P) grants him move speed while he stands near them, so Frozen Domain's speed bonus does not even buy you the chase. Play even on the wave, farm under tower if needed, and refuse extended poke trades; King's Tribute recovers chip off dying minions but cannot absorb Hextech Micro-Rockets (W) on a 7-second cooldown plus turret fire. At level 6 you get your only real pressure window: Subjugate drains his armor and MR onto you mid-fight, softening his burst for a few seconds. Place Pillar of Ice (E) across the ground he retreats over, drop Frozen Domain (W) to close, and chain Chomp (Q) autos to keep his AD drained. Even then, CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade returns every 11 seconds and UPGRADE!!! is 100 seconds at rank 1 — without jungler follow-up an upgraded turret drops you before the drain finishes.

notes: Disk 37.8% / 82 games; packet says 50.72% / 69. The disk figure is the one consistent with the entry's own prose, which describes an unwinnable 1v1 past laning, so I audited against disk. 'CH-3X Lightning Grenade' in full.breakdown.cooldowns is a fabricated ability name — it appears nowhere in Riot's data for Heimerdinger, whose only grenade is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade. Not fixed and worth a champion-level sweep: the same Chomp attack-speed-steal fabrication appears in trundle vs gnar, gwen and heimerdinger, so it is likely templated across all 71 Trundle matchups.
